posts.description: UI/UX Designer Role Summary We seek a creative UI/UX Designer to craft intuitive, intelligent, and engaging product interfaces. You will bridge user needs with technical implementation and drive design decisions from research to final delivery. Key Responsibilities Develop product strategies and create UI/UX designs, including interaction models and scalable UI frameworks. Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research (interviews, Google Analytics, etc.). Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to align on design deliverables. Produce wireframes, prototypes, and high‑fidelity mockups. Qualifications 3+ years of professional UI/UX design experience. Proficiency with design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite and Sketch. Understanding of mobile design guidelines (iOS, Android). Strong portfolio demonstrating user‑centred design process.

posts.description: Position Overview We are seeking a talented and passionate Software Developer to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in software development, a keen interest in emerging technologies, and experience leveraging AI tools to enhance development processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable software solutions that align with our strategic goals. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and deploy robust and scalable software applications. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to translate requirements into technical solutions. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in languages such as Java, Python, or C++. Develop responsive and dynamic user interfaces using modern frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js. Design, implement, and manage database systems using technologies like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and debug complex issues across the application stack. Actively utilize AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, testing, and problem-solving. Research and implement innovative technologies, particularly in AI and automation, to enhance product capabilities. Stay current with industry trends and contribute ideas for improving our technology stack and processes. Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of professional experience as a Software Developer, IT Developer, or Software Engineer. Proficiency in one or more core programming languages: Java, Python, or C++ . Hands-on experience with modern web development frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js ). Solid knowledge of database technologies (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB ). Proven experience using AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate and enhance the development lifecycle. Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with creative thinking to overcome technical challenges. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with implementing the latest AI/ML technologies to automate processes or simulate real-world functions. Exposure to or professional background in the Web3 (blockchain, DeFi, smart contracts) or AI industries. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and agile development methodologies.
